lines.l: I'm just an aging drummer boy, and in the wars I used to play
And I've called at you to many a torture session
Now they say I am a war criminal, and I'm fading away
Father, please hear my confession
I have legalized robbery, call it belief
I have a run worth of money, I have a hit like a thief
Rewritten history with my armies and my crows
Invented memories
I did burn all the boots
And I can still hear his laugh
And I can still hear his song
The man's too big
The man's too strong
When I've tried to be meek, I have tried to be mine
But I spat like a woman, and I sought like a child
I have lived behind walls that may be alone
Striven for peace, which I never have known
And I can still hear his letter, and I can still hear his song
The man's too big, the man's too strong
Well, the sun rose on the courtyard
And they all did hear him say
He always was a Judas
But I got you anyway
You may have got your silver
But I swear upon my life
Your sister gave me diamonds
And I gave them to your wife
Oh, father, please help me
For I have done wrong
The man's too big
The man's too strong
